Actor Shivani Raghuvanshi finds comedy a far more challenging genre to navigate than emotional performances. But she believes the problem goes beyond an actor's ability to make people laugh. “Writers lack an understanding of women. They don't know women, they don't sit with them and crack jokes. They think, 'women won't be funny enough.' So, if they don't understand women, how are they going to write comedy for them?” she said.
